_readme: Statutory/regulatory citations are stable historical facts and do not require a live source_url in the same way systems do, but each entry still lists the authoritative source. generate_rail_wiki.py may only cite a regulatory_hook value present here.

domain_01_service_design.title: STB oversight of major service changes
domain_01_service_design.detail: STB leadership formally requested UP provide updates on Unified Plan 2020's operating changes shortly after announcement — an example of STB's ongoing service-oversight role even outside a merger proceeding. Primary regulatory home is RR-15/RR-07.

domain_02_dispatching.title: Railroad Operating Rules — periodic instruction, testing, operational monitoring
domain_02_dispatching.detail: Requires each railroad to establish and maintain a program of periodic instruction, testing, and operational monitoring of employees involved in train operations to verify adherence to operating rules such as GCOR.

domain_02_dispatching.title: Railroad Communications
domain_02_dispatching.detail: Governs radio communication procedures used in dispatching and train movement authority.

domain_03_terminal_yard.title: Brake System Safety Standards for Freight and Other Non-Passenger Trains
domain_03_terminal_yard.detail: Governs air brake testing requirements performed at terminals/yards before train departure, including initial terminal tests.

domain_03_terminal_yard.title: Interchange inspection standards
domain_03_terminal_yard.detail: Industry-standard (not federal) rules governing car inspection at the point of interchange between railroads.

domain_04_crew_management.title: Hours of Service of Train Employees
domain_04_crew_management.detail: Statutory basis for train employee HOS: maximum 12 hours on duty, minimum 10 consecutive hours off duty (rest), limits on consecutive starts. Amended by the Rail Safety Improvement Act of 2008.

domain_04_crew_management.title: Hours of Service of Railroad Employees; Recordkeeping
domain_04_crew_management.detail: Implementing regulations for HOS recordkeeping, including electronic hours-of-service records requirements.

domain_04_crew_management.title: Qualification and Certification of Locomotive Engineers
domain_04_crew_management.detail: Certification, testing, and recertification requirements for locomotive engineers.

domain_04_crew_management.title: Qualification and Certification of Conductors
domain_04_crew_management.detail: Certification, testing, and recertification requirements for conductors.

domain_04_crew_management.title: Train Crew Size Safety Requirements
domain_04_crew_management.detail: FRA final rule mandating a minimum of two crew members on most freight train operations. Upheld 2-1 by the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals on August 11, 2026, rejecting a challenge from AAR, ASLRRA, and six railroads (including UP). The ruling denied the petitions for review but did not vacate the rule; litigation history is not necessarily closed.

domain_04_crew_management.cite: Railway Labor Act (45 U.S.C. § 151 et seq.)
domain_04_crew_management.title: Railway Labor Act
domain_04_crew_management.detail: Governs rail labor relations — Section 6 notices, National Mediation Board mediation, cooling-off periods, Presidential Emergency Boards. Distinct from the NLRA, which does not apply to railroads.

domain_05_mechanical.title: Locomotive Safety Standards
domain_05_mechanical.detail: Federal safety standards for locomotive inspection, maintenance, and equipment.

domain_05_mechanical.title: Railroad Freight Car Safety Standards
domain_05_mechanical.detail: Federal safety standards for freight car condition and defect thresholds.

domain_05_mechanical.title: Railroad Safety Appliance Standards
domain_05_mechanical.detail: Standards for grab irons, handholds, ladders, and other safety appliances on rolling stock.

domain_06_engineering.title: Track Safety Standards
domain_06_engineering.detail: Track geometry, structure, and inspection frequency standards by class of track.

domain_06_engineering.title: Track Inspections — specific inspection frequency/method requirement
domain_06_engineering.detail: The specific subsection UP petitioned FRA to temporarily suspend in 2020 to pilot autonomous track geometry measurement in place of traditional inspection methods on segments of the SPSCL and Sunset routes.

domain_06_engineering.title: Railroad Workplace Safety — Roadway Worker Protection
domain_06_engineering.detail: On-track safety rules, including Form B track authority procedures and employee-in-charge protocols.

domain_06_engineering.title: Positive Train Control Systems
domain_06_engineering.detail: PTC system standards, development plan requirements, and FRA Type Approval process. Basis for the I-ETMS PTC Development Plan filing jointly submitted by Wabtec, UP, NS, and CSX.

domain_06_engineering.title: Grade Crossing Signal System Safety
domain_06_engineering.detail: Standards for highway-rail grade crossing warning systems.

domain_06_engineering.title: Surface Transportation Board — Rail Merger Procedures (cross-referenced from RR-15)
domain_06_engineering.detail: Referenced here only because Engineering capital planning intersects with merger-driven network integration; primary home is RR-15.

domain_07_safety_regulatory.title: General Code of Operating Rules
domain_07_safety_regulatory.detail: Adopted operating rule set used by Class I railroads west of Chicago (including UP), most Class II railroads, and many short lines. Railroads east of Chicago generally use NORAC instead. UP publishes its own GCOR-based rulebook plus System Special Instructions, Timetables, Hazardous Materials Instructions, and General Orders.

domain_07_safety_regulatory.title: Railroad Operating Rules
domain_07_safety_regulatory.detail: Requires periodic instruction, testing (efficiency testing), and operational monitoring programs to verify rule compliance.

domain_07_safety_regulatory.title: Control of Alcohol and Drug Use
domain_07_safety_regulatory.detail: Federal drug and alcohol testing program requirements for safety-sensitive railroad employees.

domain_07_safety_regulatory.title: Railroad Accidents/Incidents: Reports Classification, and Investigations
domain_07_safety_regulatory.detail: Federal accident/incident reporting thresholds and procedures.

domain_07_safety_regulatory.title: STB regulatory filing and annual reporting authority
domain_07_safety_regulatory.detail: General STB regulatory oversight basis; specific merger procedures are the primary home of RR-15.

domain_08_hazmat_environmental.title: PHMSA Hazardous Materials Regulations
domain_08_hazmat_environmental.detail: Federal hazmat classification, documentation, placarding, and handling requirements for rail shipments; PHMSA (not FRA) is the primary regulator here, though FRA enforces rail-specific aspects.

domain_08_hazmat_environmental.cite: AAR Circular OT-55 (key train / TIH-PIH handling)
domain_08_hazmat_environmental.title: Recommended railroad operating and handling rules for TIH/PIH and key trains
domain_08_hazmat_environmental.detail: Industry (not federal) standard governing route selection, speed restrictions, and handling practices for toxic-inhalation-hazard/poison-inhalation-hazard materials and key trains. Named generically here; verify exact circular number/edition before citing a specific provision.
domain_08_hazmat_environmental.caution: confirm current circular number before citing a specific clause

domain_08_hazmat_environmental.title: Tank car standards
domain_08_hazmat_environmental.detail: AAR manual standard governing tank car design, construction, and inspection specifications.

domain_09_intermodal_automotive.title: CBP voluntary supply-chain security partnership
domain_09_intermodal_automotive.detail: UP states it is a partner in CBP's Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism program, designed to develop, enhance, and maintain effective supply-chain security. Relevant to RR-09 international/cross-border intermodal and RR-11 cross-border interchange.

domain_10_commercial.title: Common carrier obligation
domain_10_commercial.detail: Statutory basis for a railroad's obligation to provide transportation on reasonable request — foundational to RR-10 contract/demurrage process design. Cite generically; do not attach a specific UP tariff clause without sourcing.

domain_11_interline_equipment.title: Equipment registration for interchange eligibility
domain_11_interline_equipment.detail: Umler is the industry's official source for accepting freight cars into interchange service under these rules.

domain_11_interline_equipment.title: Company/Mark ID registration requirement
domain_11_interline_equipment.detail: Requires companies to hold an assigned Mark/Company ID to participate in interchange and Railinc systems.

domain_11_interline_equipment.cite: AAR Circular OT-10 (Code of Car Service and Car Hire Rules)
domain_11_interline_equipment.title: Car hire and car service rules
domain_11_interline_equipment.detail: Governs car hire billing, including superstructure cost data under Appendix T.

domain_11_interline_equipment.title: Freight station registration
domain_11_interline_equipment.detail: Requires all freight stations be recorded in the Centralized Station Master (CSM) with an FSAC number from the Official Railroad Station List.

domain_12_technology.cite: TSA Security Directive 1580/82-2022-01 series (freight + passenger rail cybersecurity)
domain_12_technology.title: Rail Cybersecurity Mitigation Actions and Testing
domain_12_technology.detail: Performance-based TSA cybersecurity requirements for rail 'Critical Cyber Systems,' first issued October 2022, renewed annually with revisions (current version 1580/82-2022-01C, effective May 2 2024, expires May 2 2025 per that revision — TSA has continued to renew this series annually; verify the current live revision number before citing). Applies to each freight railroad carrier identified in 49 CFR 1580.101. Requires designation of a Cybersecurity Coordinator available to TSA/CISA at all times, and a Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan. Directive 1580/82-2022-01C specifically requires PTC systems be included in the Critical Cyber Systems list — directly relevant to RR-06's PTC content.
domain_12_technology.as_of: 2024-05-02 (revision 01C); series renewed annually since Oct 2022 — check tsa.gov/sd-and-ea for the current live revision before citing a specific expiration date
domain_12_technology.cross_domain_owner: RR-06 (PTC as a designated Critical Cyber System)

domain_12_technology.title: Statutory authority for TSA security directives
domain_12_technology.detail: Statutory basis under which TSA issues rail cybersecurity security directives (originating authority also traces to the Aviation and Transportation Security Act).

domain_13_finance.cite: STB fuel surcharge calculation decision (referenced in UP FY2006 10-K)
domain_13_finance.title: STB limits on fuel surcharge calculation methodology
domain_13_finance.detail: STB issued a decision limiting the manner in which US railroads can calculate fuel surcharges on STB-regulated traffic. UP stated it did not believe this would prevent it from using fuel surcharges on most/all traffic. Verify current status/docket number before citing specifics.
domain_13_finance.caution: verify current STB fuel-surcharge rule status before treating as UP's present practice

domain_14_hr_labor.cite: Railway Labor Act (45 U.S.C. § 151 et seq.)
domain_14_hr_labor.title: Railway Labor Act
domain_14_hr_labor.detail: Governs all rail labor relations, cross-referenced from RR-04. Section 6 notices, NMB mediation, cooling-off periods, Presidential Emergency Boards.

domain_15_merger_integration.title: Major Rail Consolidation Procedures
domain_15_merger_integration.detail: STB's controlling regulation for major merger applications, including completeness requirements (the basis on which the STB rejected UP/NS's first application in January 2026), Operating Plan and Service Assurance Plan content, and the statutory 12-month evidentiary timeline from acceptance.

not_yet_sourced_do_not_use: Any state-specific PUC/DOT crossing regulations layered on top of federal rules.
Specific numeric FRA track class speed limits by class — pull directly from 49 CFR 213 subpart B table before citing numbers, do not reproduce from memory.
PHMSA-specific tank car phase-out deadlines (e.g., DOT-111 retirement dates) — confirm current status before citing a specific year.
